items.briefing:
Australian CIOs are raising concerns that organisations are rushing into AI adoption faster than they can put proper safeguards in place — a reminder that staff should think carefully before using AI tools with sensitive organisational data. Separately, attackers are actively exploiting a security flaw in N-able, a remote monitoring and management platform used by many IT service providers. If your organisation uses a managed IT provider, it's worth checking they've applied the latest patches.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT provider or helpdesk whether their remote management software is fully up to date — especially if they use N-able.

featured.title: Australian CIOs warn AI ambition outpaces governance
featured.quote: Australian CIOs struggle with AI governance as spending accelerates without proper oversight frameworks.
